summary: The is_reconfigured run failed to compile (exit 101, no events) because the method returns Option<StopSign>, not Option<bool>; the failure is preserved as a construction failure. This revision fixes only the encoding: n3_reconfig and n4_reconfig now record 0 when is_reconfigured() is None and 1 when it is Some. Everything else is unchanged: the seeded 900-action schedule, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, 150-round fair-delivery convergence, node 3 ordered trace, node 4 promise diagnostics and the converged_all comparison. The receipt will settle the last open point in the StopSign-resync account. If node 3 reports a StopSign while the leader decided 38, then node 3 did not miss the AcceptStopSign: it holds the reconfiguration marker and is stuck because the decided position beyond it never arrived, which would reclassify the case under the StopSign-clearing family. If node 3 reports no StopSign, the original reading stands and the clamping sequence-expected Decides are what block it. Either outcome leaves the executed progress loss itself established, with agreement unaffected.
